blocks.text: 25 questions: five from each of the 5 chapters, in a random order.

Your first answer to each question is the one that counts. 85% or better passes, and passing earns the badge for The Prepositional Case. You can take it as often as you like; the questions are dealt afresh each time.

exercises.q: Мы работаем на ___ (фабрика, prep. sg.).
exercises.prompt: We work in a factory.
